flagged.title: Brest-Litovsk and the Civil War, 1918–21
flagged.reason: The video prominently features and narrates incorrect headline statistics for Brest-Litovsk (25% of population and 25% of industry instead of 34% and 54%), which would teach students inaccurate historical figures on an examined specification topic.

mark_affecting.quote: The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk cost Russia a staggering 25% of its entire population... another 25% of its entire industry... they lost almost half, 50% of their grain-producing land

flagged.title: The Five-Year Plans and Soviet Industry
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly dates Stalin's famous '50 or 100 years behind' speech to 1927 rather than February 1931, presenting it as a pre-plan justification rather than an address three years into the First Five-Year Plan.

mark_affecting.quote: In 1927 Stalin famously declared, 'We are 50 or 100 years behind the advanced countries...'
